Wordgrid Solver

Wordgrid Solver

Paste a screenshot of a word search and it lists every real word hiding in it, forwards, backwards and on every diagonal.

The letters read from the image land here, one row per line. You can also type or paste letters directly. This is a loaded example.

Matches, most likely first

    Grid

    Pick a match to light it up. The outlined cell is where the word starts, and the arrow shows which way it reads. Row and column numbers count from 1 at the top left. A match tagged “1 off” fits the grid except for the marked letter, which usually means the image reader misjudged that letter.
